# VEESIBI
> VEESIBI (veesibi.com) is an AI Search Visibility Scorecard and llms.txt validator. It audits any domain across 10 specialized metrics — llms.txt compliance, AI crawler permissions, JSON-LD schemas, multi-engine citation authority, and GEO share of voice — and generates one-click remediation code for llms.txt, robots.txt, and structured data.

## Core Tools
- [Instant AI Visibility Scorecard](https://veesibi.com): Free unauthenticated domain audit scoring AI search readiness across 10 sub-metrics with letter grade.
- [llms.txt Syntax Validator](https://veesibi.com/llms-txt/validator): Interactive real-time parser and linter against Jeremy Howard's September 2024 llms.txt specification with auto-fix.
- [Verified AI-Ready Badge](https://veesibi.com/badge/veesibi.com): Dynamic SVG badge for domains scoring above 85/100 linking to their public scorecard.

## Programmatic SEO
- [AI Search Versus Benchmarks Directory](https://veesibi.com/compare): Head-to-head AI visibility comparisons across 30 SaaS competitor pairs.
- [Industry Sector Benchmarks](https://veesibi.com/industry): Category Share of Voice reports across SaaS, FinTech, Developer Tools, AI Infrastructure, E-Commerce, and Cybersecurity.

## Scorecards
- [stripe.com AI Scorecard](https://veesibi.com/score/stripe.com): Public AI visibility report for Stripe.
- [linear.app AI Scorecard](https://veesibi.com/score/linear.app): Public AI visibility report for Linear.
- [vercel.com AI Scorecard](https://veesibi.com/score/vercel.com): Public AI visibility report for Vercel.
- [github.com AI Scorecard](https://veesibi.com/score/github.com): Public AI visibility report for GitHub.

## API
- [Run Audit Endpoint](https://veesibi.com/api/audit): POST endpoint accepting {"domain": "example.com"} returning full DomainAuditResult JSON with 10 sub-scores, vulnerabilities, citations, and generated remediation snippets.

## Standards
- [llms.txt Specification (Jeremy Howard)](https://llmstxt.org): The llms.txt standard for orienting LLM agents to website content.
- OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot explicitly allowed in robots.txt.
- JSON-LD SoftwareApplication and Organization schema validated on all scorecard pages.
